verses.1: Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.
verses.2: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.3: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.
verses.4: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.
verses.5: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.6: Yea, see thou thy children ’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
